mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are called 𝑥−𝑎𝑥𝑖𝑠 and 𝑦−𝑎𝑥𝑖𝑠 and their point of intersection is called the origin."
The lines are called 𝑥−𝑎𝑥𝑖𝑠 and 𝑦−𝑎𝑥𝑖𝑠 and their point of intersection is called the origin.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a factor of the ellipse, which demonstrates the elongation of it and is denoted by 𝑒."
Eccentricity is a factor of the ellipse, which demonstrates the elongation of it and is denoted by 𝑒.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a line that passes through a point on a curve."
A tangent is a line that passes through a point on a curve.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are derived from the course competences and objectives."
The modules are derived from the course competences and objectives.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the locus of points in a plane such that the sum of their distances from two fixed points in the plane, is constant."
An ellipse is the locus of points in a plane such that the sum of their distances from two fixed points in the plane, is constant.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is called the origin or centre of the circle and fixed distance of the points from the origin is called the radius."
The fixed point is called the origin or centre of the circle and fixed distance of the points from the origin is called the radius.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a line segment that passes through the centre of the hyperbola and has vertices as its endpoints."
The transverse axis is a line segment that passes through the centre of the hyperbola and has vertices as its endpoints.
fib: ______ is the central line about which the cone is symmetric.
axis
The axis is the central line about which the cone is symmetric.
______ can be defined as set of points in the coordinate plane.
Hyperbola
Hyperbola can be defined as set of points in the coordinate plane.
______ is a line which, when rotated about the axis, sweeps out the cone.
generator
A generator is a line which, when rotated about the axis, sweeps out the cone.
______ are known as the foci (singular focus), which are surrounded by the curve, The fixed line is directrix and constant ratio is eccentricity of ellipse.
fixed points
The fixed points are known as the foci (singular focus), which are surrounded by the curve, The fixed line is directrix and constant ratio is eccentricity of ellipse.
______ is defined as the product of magnitude of vector 𝐴 and magnitude of component of vector 𝐵 in the direction of vector 𝐴 (vice-versa).
scalar
The scalar is defined as the product of magnitude of vector 𝐴 and magnitude of component of vector 𝐵 in the direction of vector 𝐴 (vice-versa).
______ is called semi-major axis and half of minor axis is called semi-minor axis (see Fig 3.1.1).
Half of major axis
Half of major axis is called semi-major axis and half of minor axis is called semi-minor axis (see Fig 3.1.1).
______ is the longest diameter of the ellipse, going through the centre from one end to the other, at the broad part of the ellipse.
major axis
The major axis is the longest diameter of the ellipse, going through the centre from one end to the other, at the broad part of the ellipse.
